gaps.explanation: p4-p5 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds prints General, Street, Keno, LB840 Economic Development, LB840 Infrastructure and Total columns. detail[] has only the General Fund departments (pp11-12, 1,121,792 = General column 1,073,686 + nonoperating 48,104, 2 dollars of department rounding). The other four columns have no schedule and no revenue lines in detail. Printed non-zero rows: Street (p4) Property taxes 2,824, Motor vehicle 23,431, Highway allocation 196,596, Highway incentive 3,000, Motor vehicle fees 13,394 (= Total revenues 239,245; p5 Interest income prints 0, not added); Keno Keno proceeds 37,292 (p4) + Interest income 3,404 (p5); LB840 Economic Development Sales tax - LB840 56,586 (p4) + Interest income 75 (p5); LB840 Infrastructure Sales tax - LB840 113,172 (p4) + Interest income 151 (p5). Sum of adds 449,925. Check: 1,121,792 + 449,925 = 1,571,717 vs statement 1,571,716 (1 = the report's own rounding in the General department cells, p11 cells 1,073,688 vs printed 1,073,686 + General nonoperating).

The LB840 Economic Development column is in no schedule: p4 Personnel 48, Advertising 703, Contract services 525, Taxes 4 (= its printed total 1,280). Added as printed: 1,933,891 + 1,280 = 1,935,171. The remaining -4 against the JSON statement total 1,935,167 is the report's own rounding and cannot be closed with printed amounts: the Total-column rows on p4-p5 add to 1,935,167 while the printed Total expenditures paid is 1,935,169 and the printed column totals add to 1,935,170 (row cells vs Total column differ by 1 on Personnel 314,127/314,126, Contract services 62,000/61,999, Office 30,936/30,935, Repairs 66,526/66,525, Taxes 23,712/23,713), plus 1 in the General department cells (1,790,902 vs printed 1,790,901). No derived plug added.

gaps.explanation: p7 proprietary statement: Total operating expenses 417,698 + Interest and fees expense 28,720 = 446,418 (JSON disbursements). detail has only the p10 all-funds budgetary-basis function lines Water 160,399 (detail[125]), Wastewater 42,101 (detail[126]), Sanitation 137,036 (detail[127]) = 339,536: the same Water / Sewer / Sanitation funds' spending on the budgetary cash basis (no depreciation). Adding the p7 fund-column rows without removing them would count each fund's spending twice, so detail[125]-[127] are removed and replaced by the p7 rows. Water: Personnel 22,751, Contract services 596, Meetings, seminars, and dues 1,837, Office 11,771, Insurance 12,425, Repairs and maintenance 2,391, Taxes 2,154, Utilities 12,911, Supplies 1,261, Miscellaneous 156, Depreciation and amortization 113,513 (= 181,766) + Interest and fees expense 5,432; Sewer: 20,082 + 822 + 907 + 255 + 12,711 + 2,238 + 5,199 + 150 + 54,288 (= 96,652) + interest 23,287; Sanitation: Personnel 7,445, Contract services 129,826, Taxes 548, Depreciation and amortization 1,461 (= 139,280; printed 139,279). Electric prints no expense. Adds 446,417; 339,536 - 339,536 + 446,417 = 446,417 vs 446,418 (1 = report rounding: Sanitation rows 139,280 vs printed 139,279 and interest 5,432 + 23,287 = 28,719 vs printed 28,720).
